# NOSOCOMIAL PNEUMONIA WITH ACINETOBACTER BAUMANNII

Infectious Diseases consultation is essential for cases with Acinetobacter which are often resistant to most therapies.

# Consult ID if Carbapenemase gene detected (IMP, KPC, NDM, OXA-48, VIM)

---

References:

- Kalil AC et al. Clin Infect Dis 2016. 63:1
- Up-to-date website
Therapy:
## Empiric treatment

Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h R,O

< OR >
Ampicillin-sulbactam 3 gm IV q4h R,O
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU ABX NOSOCOMIAL A. BAUMANNII
